title: Plots
description: Plot one column against another, from a table you upload or from the samples of an experiment.

upload.description: Drop a CSV or Excel table that is not in any experiment. It is read in your browser; nothing is saved.
upload.tooFewNumbers: This table needs at least two columns of numbers to plot. Check the header row.

experiment.noProjects: There are no projects yet. Create one first.
experiment.noExperiments: This project has no experiments yet.
experiment.pickHint: Choose a project and an experiment to plot its samples.
experiment.noSamples: This experiment has no samples to plot.
experiment.tooFewNumbers: This experiment needs at least two columns of numbers to plot.
experiment.selected: {count, plural, one {Showing # selected sample} other {Showing # selected samples}}

chart.label: Scatter plot of {y} against {x}
chart.folded: {count, plural, one {# more group is shown as Other} other {# more groups are shown as Other}}
chart.empty: Nothing to plot: no sample has a number for both axes.
chart.summary: {count, plural, one {# sample plotted} other {# samples plotted}}
chart.missing: {count, plural, one {# left out (no value)} other {# left out (no value)}}
chart.notPositive: {count, plural, one {# left out (0 or less on a log axis)} other {# left out (0 or less on a log axis)}}

filters.title: Filters
filters.tickHint: Tick the values to keep. Nothing ticked keeps all.
filters.none: No filters. Add one to keep only some samples, for example one number of cycles.
filters.filteredOut: {count, plural, one {# left out by filters} other {# left out by filters}}

selection.title: Choose the points
selection.hint: Untick a sample to remove its point from the chart. Nothing is deleted.

save.title: Save this plot
save.description: Saves the columns, filters and ticked samples, not a picture. When you open it later it is drawn from the experiment's current samples.

errors.nameDuplicate: Another saved plot of this experiment has this title.

saved.title: Saved plots
saved.empty: No saved plots yet. Set up a plot and use Save plot.
saved.unavailable: This saved plot cannot be opened any more, because the experiment no longer has two columns of numbers.
saved.confirmDescription: {name} will be removed. Only the saved plot is deleted: your samples and data are not touched.

customise.title: Customise
customise.caption: On exported figures
customise.showSource: Show where the data is from
customise.showCounts: Show how many samples were plotted and left out
